turns.text: Start incorporating them into your daily conversations.
turns.zh: 把它们用到你每天的对话里。

turns.text: The most important thing is to just start having more conversations in English.
turns.zh: 最重要的就是先开始多开口说英语。

turns.text: Don't wait until your English is good enough.
turns.zh: 别等到你的英语够好了才开始。
现在就开始练这些技能。

turns.text: Whether it's with co-workers, family members, or new friends, every conversation is an opportunity to improve.
turns.zh: 不管是跟同事、家人还是新朋友，每一次对话都是提升的机会。

turns.text: Before we go, we want to remind you that making mistakes is completely normal and actually helps you learn faster.
turns.zh: 在结束之前，我们想提醒你，犯错是完全正常的，而且其实能帮你学得更快。

turns.text: The people in today's conversations weren't using complicated grammar or fancy vocabulary.
turns.zh: 今天对话里的人也没用什么复杂的语法或高级词汇。
